summary.content:
Today's selection covers 88 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 54 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Rare look at the remote engine rooms powering China's AI ambitions
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ryuk ransomware member sentenced to 24 months in prison
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 65 articles published in the last 24 hours
